note: Base-zone scalar rows transcribed from City of Kyle Code of Ordinances Ch. 53 (Zoning) Sec. 53-33(k) 'Chart 1' (front/side/corner/rear/height, https://ecode360.com/45580734) and Sec. 53-33(l) 'Chart 2' (coverage, https://ecode360.com/45580735), current-through Ord. No. 1409 adopted 6/2/2026 per the eCode360 currency banner; Sec. 53-33 itself was last substantively amended by Ordinance 1332, adopted 8/20/2024, with no later amendment shown against it. Accessed 2026-09-06. AMBIGUITY DISCLOSED, not resolved: Sec. 53-33(l) is captioned 'Impervious coverage' and its operative sentence says impervious surfaces 'shall not exceed that set forth in chart 2,' but Chart 2's own column header reads 'Maximum Lot Coverage by Percent.' No separate building-footprint-only coverage table was found anywhere in Sec. 53-33. Both max_lot_coverage_pct and max_impervious_pct below carry the same Chart 2 number for each district; max_impervious_pct is the better-supported reading (subsection heading + operative cross-reference), max_lot_coverage_pct is a non-binding sentinel carried at the same value because the column header nominally names it that. ADDED: R-1-1, R-1-2, R-1-3, R-1-A, R-2. R-1-A side_ft is a non-binding sentinel: Chart 1 footnote (2) states the real rule is asymmetric zero-lot-line ('ten feet on one side, and a zero lot line is permitted on the other side'), not a single scalar; the more conservative 10' value is carried as the sentinel. Front-setback cells for R-1-1/R-1-2/R-1-3/R-2 carry Chart 1 footnote (9), a discretionary council-approval mechanism permitting up to 20% front-setback reduction (floor 16') on up to 50% of lots in a subdivision under conditions; the tabulated (non-reduced) value is used as the base row per this corpus's convention of reporting the default standard, not a discretionary exception. OMITTED, not fabricated: R-1 (footnote (16): 'R-1 zoning is limited to existing lots zoned R-1 per Ordinance Number 92' -- legacy, not assignable to new parcels); R-1-T and R-1-C (Chart 1 explicitly defers their front/side/rear/lot-area cells to Division 5 and Division 6 of Article II respectively -- 'See division 5/6 of this article' -- those division sections were not retrieved in this pass, so no scalar values are asserted for R-1-T or R-1-C); R-3-1, R-3-2, R-3-3 (multifamily); M-1, M-2, M-3 (manufactured home); CBD-1, CBD-2, RS, B, W, CM, E, TU, HS, RV, NC, CC, MXD, O/I (commercial/industrial/mixed-use); A (agricultural) and UE (urban estate); all Article III overlay districts. Kyle is in Hays County (FIPS 48209).
